items.summary: It's the little space probe that could: Nearly 50 years after it was launched, NASA's Voyager 1 on Wednesday became the first human-made object to travel one light-day — or 16 billion miles — away from Earth.

items.title: Would Ukraine trade land for NATO membership or protection?
